initialMessage: You cannot share a job directly via a native 'Share Job' control in Messaging. However, you can type the job reference as text in a message or attach a file you're authorized to share. Creating a group doesn't share a job. Keep private job records out of Messaging.

sources.title: Share a Job in a message
sources.guidance: I cannot verify a native Share Job control or Job card in Messaging. This is a documentation limit, not proof that the feature is absent. Ordinary text and attachments are supported in conversations you are authorized to access: type the appropriate Job reference as message text, or choose Attach for a file you are allowed to share, then choose Send. Creating a group by itself does not share a Job. Keep private Job records out of TenBot.
